public_brief.player_opening: She can pass through or keep pushing.
public_brief.reply_to: Our kind look after our own. No toll between family, surely?

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer holds her gaze, then laughs softly and sweeps a hand toward the south door as if opening a curtain. Behind him the fourth player lets out a breath he has been holding.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Family. Yes. How could I take coin from family? Pass freely, cousin, and forgive an old host his habits. The dead are greedy, but they are not rude to their own.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: The toll is waived. What do you do?
